text_block_list.text:
Today is Valentine's Day.
Amidst all the mingled feelings and excitement, as for Mr. C.B.—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"CB-senpai!
Please accept these chocolates!!"

I wondered why so many Umamusume were gathered so early in the morning,
and it turned out they were all waiting for Mr. C.B. to show up.
Every single one was clutching a wrapped package of their own.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Oh, today's Valentine's Day, huh.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Thank you.
Alright, I'll take them one by one.
Both Mr. C.B. and the other Umamusume seemed used to it, as the chocolate handoff proceeded briskly and without a hitch.

As I watched over them,
the thing that caught my attention was—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
—I probably won't be able to give you what you're hoping for.
Are you still okay with that?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
...Hk, yes, I know...!
Even so... I want you to have this.
So... here, please take it!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Yeah, thanks.

Mr. C.B. made sure to look each person right in the eye.
The brief gaze she offered was intensely sincere.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: —Oh, quite a stack this year too, huh.

When I suggested using the trainer's office as temporary storage
for the chocolates she received...
one corner quickly filled up completely.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Maybe it's even more impressive than last year.
Is this what you'd call a side effect of the race?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Haha, seems like it.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
“Even when I tell them ‘I cannot return your feelings’...
it turns out like this every year.”
choice_data_list: I was actually curious about that...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I've always made sure to say that upfront.
I want to draw a clear line from the start, you see.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
It's a story from back when I was a kid, though—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Back then, I was even more self-centered than I am now... or rather, I didn't even try to hide it. Naturally, I was an outcast in class, but...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
There was a girl who worked up the courage to give me chocolates, y'know.
I just casually took 'em thinking, "Yay, a snack~"

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Once I ate it, I totally forgot about it and never returned the favor.
Then one day, while I was hanging out with friends,
that kid came barging in on us.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: "Even though you accepted my feelings, why are you hanging out with other girls?!" ...She blew up at me with tears in her eyes.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Right, exactly. I figured if we double-check when receiving it, nobody gets the wrong idea.
choice_data_list: How about just not accepting it in the first place?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I tried that too, but everyone
seems happier when they're the ones giving it.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
...Though, thinking about it now, it's pretty strange.
I figured it was fine as long as everyone was happy, but...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Even knowing it won't reach,
you still want to give them something...
I wonder what makes people feel that way?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"After all, if conveying your feelings is the goal,
you don't really need chocolate, right?"

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Am I just someone who's easy to give to
when people feel like getting in on Valentine's?
Is that all I am?
choice_data_list: (She's really reached a state of zen...)

text_block_list.text:
I could understand why she was wondering about it.
Wanting to give someone chocolate, even while knowing your feelings will never be returned...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
...Hk, yes, I know...!
Even so... I want you to have this.
So... here, please take it!

The chocolate is something you can hold in your hands.
A tangible weight. What is poured into it is surely—a painful, yet trivial wish.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
...A weight?
choice_data_list: Like... maybe having even a little influence on you...
Like... maybe having even a little influence on you...

text_block_list.text:
Even if you give her words, they quickly vanish from within her.
She is free, unbound by even the strongest of emotions—
completely unaffected by anything.

choice_data_list: Even if it's just a little bit...

text_block_list.text:
Reflecting on my own words, I felt a wave of embarrassment.
Seeing so many unrequited feelings since this morning
must have made me overly sentimental.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I'm surprised.
You really sound like an author sometimes.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I see.
You want to influence me...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
...Too bad, though.
I just can't bring myself to answer you.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Because—

She suddenly bolted, and I scrambled to chase after her.
Naturally, I couldn't catch up to her backâ

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: I don't feel weighed down at all! It feels like I've shaken off every single burden.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
You can pour all the feelings you want into it.
But I will never feel them—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Not even the tiniest wish
can reach me anymore.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Hey, do you think this is cruel?
choice_data_list: Nothing you can do. The one who falls in love first loses, after all.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Haha, I see.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: By the way, about what we were discussing earlier...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Are those words coming from personal experience, by any chance?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Have you ever fallen in love with someone out of reach?
I'm quite interested in hearing stories like that about you.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Come on, it's me we're talking about.
Tell me.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
A story from your school days? Or from after you became a Trainer?
Come on, tell me, tell me!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you look troubled.
Does that mean... it's actually true?

Unusually for her, Mr. C.B. continued
to fool around with me after that.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"Did you find CB-senpai?
Where could she be...?!"
choice_data_list: Looks like they're looking for you.
Looks like they're looking for you.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: "...Hearing your story really makes my heart ache."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
She's so earnest, really...
What does she even see in me?
choice_data_list: I think I kinda get it.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Huh?

One look at her running tells you everything. Free and unconventional,
she will surely never be caught. Even so,
I cannot suppress how drawn I am to her—
choice_data_list: It means I can't just give up on you
It means it's hard for me to give up on you.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ...Huh.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Then...
don't give up.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"Don't give up on me.
—...Okay?"

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I guess I'll head over to the girls.
I'd feel bad making them keep searching for me.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Ah, that's right.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Happy Valentine's!
